facts.fact: According to Nielsen's May 2025 rankings, Tubi reached a record 2.2% share of total TV usage.
facts.quote: Tubi reached a record 2.2% share of total TV usage, up from 1.9% and representing over 60% growth since debuting on the Nielsen Gauge just over a year ago.

facts.fact: Tubi's growth since debuting on the Nielsen Gauge is over 60%, per the page citing Nielsen.
facts.quote: representing over 60% growth since debuting on the Nielsen Gauge just over a year ago

facts.fact: Netflix's share of TV viewing is listed at 7.8% in the page's May 2025 Nielsen comparison.
facts.quote: Netflix (7.8%)

facts.fact: Hulu's share of TV viewing is listed at 3.1% in the page's May 2025 comparison.
facts.quote: Hulu**: 3.1% (mixed subscription/ad model)

facts.fact: The Roku Channel's share of TV viewing is listed at 2.8% in the page's May 2025 comparison.
facts.quote: The Roku Channel**: 2.8% (fully ad-supported)

facts.fact: Peacock's share of TV viewing is listed at 2.0% in the page's May 2025 comparison.
facts.quote: Peacock**: 2.0% (mixed model)

facts.fact: Industry-standard ad loads on FAST services like Tubi are typically 8-10 minutes per hour, as stated by the page.
facts.quote: Industry-standard ad loads (typically 8-10 minutes per hour)

facts.fact: Adwave states that its minimum daily budget for advertising is $30 a day.
facts.quote: $30-a-day minimum**: Low barrier to entry

facts.fact: Adwave states that its channel mix includes Tubi within more than 100 channels.
facts.quote: Adwave**: Includes Tubi in 100+ channel mix

facts.fact: FAST stands for Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television, the model Tubi uses.
facts.quote: This FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) model attracts viewers seeking streaming content without monthly payments

facts.fact: Tubi's 2.2% share is measured across all TV viewing, including streaming plus traditional broadcast and cable.
facts.quote: Its 2.2% share of all TV viewing (streaming plus traditional broadcast and cable)

facts.fact: Nielsen Gauge data from May 2025 shows Tubi holds 2.2% of total TV viewing, including streaming and traditional broadcast/cable.
facts.quote: Tubi holds 2.2% of total TV viewing according to Nielsen Gauge data from May 2025.

facts.fact: The page states Tubi's share of TV viewing has grown over 60% in the past year.
facts.quote: Tubi's share has grown over 60% in the past year, making it one of the fastest-growing streaming platforms.

facts.fact: The page reports Netflix holds approximately 7.8% of total TV viewing for comparison.
facts.quote: Netflix holds approximately 7.8% of total TV viewing compared to Tubi's 2.2%.

facts.fact: The page states Tubi's ad load is similar to traditional TV, at approximately 8-10 minutes of ads per hour of content.
facts.quote: with ad loads similar to traditional TV (approximately 8-10 minutes of ads per hour of content).

facts.fact: The page states Tubi is completely free for viewers and is supported entirely by advertising.
facts.quote: Yes, Tubi is completely free for viewers.

facts.fact: Adwave states campaigns on its platform start at $30 a day, giving access to Tubi and 100+ other streaming channels.
facts.quote: campaigns starting at just $30 a day

facts.fact: Adwave states it offers access to 100+ channels, including Tubi inventory.
facts.quote: provides access to Tubi and 100+ other streaming channels

facts.fact: Adwave states AI-generated creative is included at no additional cost.
facts.quote: AI-generated creative at no additional cost

facts.fact: Adwave states there are no production budget, no agency fees, and no minimum commitments required.
facts.unit: USD production budget or agency fees
facts.quote: No production budget needed. No agency fees. No minimum commitments.
